room.unknown: Saakshi can't read how much room this phone has free. It will not stop a recording for lack of room.

explain.title: Room on your phone
explain.long: Body-cam and Pocket recording are made for long recordings that nobody is watching, so Saakshi looks after the phone's room for them.
explain.perHour: An hour of body-cam video takes about {{video}}. An hour of sound takes about {{sound}}.
explain.keepFree: Saakshi leaves {{amount}} of the phone free for everything else. You can change this in Settings, under Storage.
explain.atKeepFreeSoundOnly: When only that much is left, body-cam stops video and carries on recording sound, which takes far less room. Pocket recording stops and saves its recording.
explain.atKeepFreeStop: When only that much is left, body-cam and Pocket recording stop and save the recording.
explain.floor: Saakshi never records into the last {{floor}} of the phone. That room is kept so that a recording can always be closed and signed. There, every recording stops and is saved.
explain.phoneTaken: “My phone is being taken” keeps recording past the amount you keep free, down to that last {{floor}}.

start.belowKeepFree: Saakshi can't start recording. The phone has {{free}} free, and Saakshi keeps {{amount}} free for everything else. Make room on the phone, or lower the amount in Settings, under Storage.
start.belowFloor: Saakshi can't start recording. The phone has only {{free}} free, and Saakshi never records into the last {{floor}}. Make room on the phone first.

warn.video: Room for about {{minutes}} more minutes of video.
warn.sound: Room for about {{minutes}} more minutes of sound.
warn.soundOnly: The phone is down to the room you keep free. Video has stopped. Sound is still recording.
warn.pastKeepFree: The phone is below the room you keep free. Recording carries on until the phone is almost full.
warn.stoppedKeepFree: The phone was down to the room you keep free, so the recording was stopped and saved.
warn.stoppedFloor: The phone was almost full, so the recording was stopped and saved.
warn.unknown: Saakshi can't read how much room is left. Recording carries on.

settings.freeUnknown: Saakshi can't read how much of this phone is free.
settings.usedNone: Saakshi has no recordings on this phone.
settings.keepFreeBody: How much of the phone Saakshi leaves for everything else. Body-cam and Pocket recording stop before they use this room.
settings.soundOnlyOn: Stop video and keep recording sound
settings.soundOnlyBody: Sound takes far less room than video, so a recording that would have stopped can carry on for hours.
